crossRefs.note: then all the Jews returned out of all places where they were driven, and came to the land of Judah, to Gedaliah, to…
We remember the fish, which we ate in Egypt for nothing; the cucumbers, and the melons, and the leeks, and the onions…
but now we have lost our appetite. There is nothing at all except this manna to look at.”
They tell God, ‘Depart from us, for we don’t want to know about your ways.
What is the Almighty, that we should serve him? What profit should we have, if we pray to him?’
They have set their mouth in the heavens. Their tongue walks through the earth.
“Your words have been stout against me,” says Yahweh. “Yet you say, ‘What have we spoken against you?’

translations.web: But since we stopped burning incense to the queen of the sky, and pouring out drink offerings to her, we have lacked all things, and have been consumed by the sword and by the famine.
translations.bsb: But from the time we stopped burning incense to the Queen of Heaven and pouring out drink offerings to her, we have lacked everything and have been perishing by sword and famine.”
translations.kjv: But since we left off to burn incense to the queen of heaven, and to pour out drink offerings unto her, we have wanted all things, and have been consumed by the sword and by the famine.
translations.asv: But since we left off burning incense to the queen of heaven, and pouring out drink-offerings unto her, we have wanted all things, and have been consumed by the sword and by the famine.
